pages.title: Crusher Spirits
pages.text: Crusher spirits are summoned to crush ores into dusts, effectively multiplying the metal output.$(br)   They will pick up appropriate ores and drop the resulting dusts into the world.$(br)   A spark particle effect and a crushing sound $()

pages.title: Crusher Spirits
pages.text: indicate the crusher is at work.$(br)

pages.title: Automation
pages.text: To ease automation, try summoning a $(l:summoning_rituals/summon_transport_items)Transporter Spirit$(/l) to place items from chests$(br) in the crusher's inventory, and a $(l:summoning_rituals/summon_cleaner)Janitor Spirit$(/l) to collect the processed items.$(br)

pages.title: Foliot Crusher
pages.text: The foliot crusher is the most basic crusher spirit.$(br2) $(br) It will crush $(bold)one$() ore into $(bold)two$() corresponding dusts.$(br)

pages.title: Filters
pages.text: This spirit already only picks up items it has recipes for.$(br)Put a $(item)list filter$() or $(item)attribute filter$() into its filter slot to further restrict which valid inputs it will take.$(br)See Spirit Filters for filter details.$()
